lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in at least six vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with spot diameter and inter-spot distance increasing toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient (light upper edge, shadowed lower edge) running parallel to the shark's body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) associated with the ventral region and trailing the pectoral fin, including one large individual visible in the background mid-water column.
